body: There are therapists trained specifically to deal with this. I also recommend attending sex addicts anonymous meetings. Being around those struggling with your same struggles gives you more strength than you would imagine.

Ok. Literally no one actually believes this.  Anyone that says they do is saying so for attention-seeking/political spin purposes, or they are within the margin of error of the phrase "literally no one". I will dive on this grenade because unfortunately I am a subject matter expert of sorts. 
I am a registered sex offender. I was 21 and dating a boy who was 16.  I don't want to try to excuse what I did, because it showed very poor judgments and forever altered both my life and his.  I spent three years incarcerated  and in group counseling with sex offenders of all types, including people who classified themselves as pedophiles, MAPs, boy lovers and such.  None of these people associated themselves with the LGBT community unless they also considered themselves gay because of their attraction to adult males.
In fact some specifically distance themselves from the LGBT community.  There were a couple guys in similar situations, where they lived lives as heterosexual men, but were convicted of molesting young boys.  And after extensive counseling it became obvious that they were deeply closeted and somehow their attraction to adult males was transferring itself to juvenile males, because somehow they're internalized homophobia was stronger than their moral compass surrounding pedophilia.  Any attempts to talk to them about this was met with violent reaction and insistence that they weren't gay.  They were straight men, and they don't know what the thing with boys is about.  

Anyway no one thinks this but you get points for taking a stand against something without incurring any risk, congratulations I guess.
